text:
Riya: quick triangulation — pulling together the monthly recurring-incident summary. top three patterns we've seen: disk pressure on gpu nodes, degraded kv-cache hit rates, and spike-induced autoscale thrash. need concrete owners + short remediation paths so these don't keep popping up next month.

Tom: disk pressure sounds familiar — most events correlate with long-running debug pods and a few large model downloads. I can own a short-term guard: node-local eviction for debug pods + alert on free disk < 12%. will open INF-4210. ETA: PR + rollout canary by Thu.

Jana: kv-cache hit-rate drop is hurting p95. looks like a mix of sharded cache misrouting after controller restarts and occasional malformed keys from legacy clients. proposal: (1) add route-level cache-key validation, (2) add a cache-resync job, (3) instrument per-shard hit-ratio. I can take this. ETA: design doc Mon, tickets after.

Diego: autoscale thrash — we had 4 incidents where scale-up created transient CPU pressure and pod preemption cascaded. short-term: increase stabilization window on scale-ups and reduce aggressive downscale. long-term: autoscaler rollout with canaries. I'll start a config RFC. ETA: RFC Tue.

pm-bot: New tracker entry created: REC-2026-03 (monthly-recurrence-synthesis). Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/rec/REC-2026-03

Riya: please add acceptance criteria: what counts as "fixed" for each. for example, disk pressure fixed = zero disk-pressure incidents for 30 days in critical pools; kv-cache fixed = median hit-rate >= 95% on production routes; autoscale fixed = no cascade preemptions for 30 days.

Tom: ACK. INF-4210 created with ACs and rollout notes. added me + infra-oncall.

Jana: creating INF-4211 for cache fixes. ACs: per-shard metrics + automated resync job with safe throttling; unit tests for key validation.

Diego: INF-4212 for autoscaler changes. ACs: canary config + rollback plan, and a dashboard for preemption counts.

InfraObserver: Observability note — added an alert for "kv-cache shard mismatch" and a saved query for preemption cascades.

Riya: schedule a 20m sync next week to confirm owners shipped canaries. propose Wed 9:30am.

Tom: good for me.

Jana: ok. I'll bring sample traces.

Diego: I'll bring the RFC and rollout gating checklist.

Riya: thanks. quick ask: whoever implements the key-validation, please keep it cheap (no per-request remote calls) — prefer local schema checks.

Jana: will do local validation + fuzz tests offline.

Tom: flagging potential blocker — infra quota for non-preemptible nodes is limited; if we need more capacity for canaries we'll need quota request. filing cloud-ticket now.

Riya: noted. if quota is slow, temp mitigation = schedule canary on quieter region.

pm-bot: Reminder scheduled: Recurrence sync Wed 09:30 (link: https://calendar.redwood/recurrence-sync)
